title: About Expedition 33 Wiki
description: About Expedition 33 Wiki - an independent, fan-run guide covering builds, bosses, walkthrough, Pictos and weapons for Clair Obscur: Expedition 33.

sections.title: What Is Expedition 33 Wiki?
sections.content:
Expedition 33 Wiki is an independent, fan-run guide site dedicated to Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. We publish practical, tested guides to help players get through the game — from character builds and boss strategies to full walkthroughs and collectible locations.

Our goal is simple: give players clear answers without fluff, ads disguised as content, or endless video intros.

sections.title: What We Cover
sections.content:
• Character Builds — detailed build guides for Maelle, Verso, Lune and the rest of the party
  • Boss Guides — strategies for every major and optional boss, in recommended order
  • Walkthrough — act-by-act progression guide covering the main story
  • Pictos & Weapons — complete lists with locations and tier rankings
  • Endings & Choices — how branching decisions affect the story
  • Combat Mechanics — parrying, dodging, and the systems that matter

sections.title: Our Editorial Approach
sections.content:
Every guide on this Site is written based on direct in-game testing and cross-referenced with official sources where possible. We aim to be accurate first and fast second — if a guide contains an error, we correct it as soon as it is reported.

We do not copy content from other sites. Where we reference community findings or datamined information, we say so.

sections.title: Disclaimer
sections.content:
Expedition 33 Wiki is an unofficial fan site. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Sandfall Interactive or Kepler Interactive.

Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 and all related names, marks, and imagery are the property of their respective owners. This Site exists to help players and to celebrate the game.

sections.title: Contact
sections.content: Found an error, or have a suggestion? Reach us at contact@expedition33.wiki.
